permission_request_message:
# Why we need your location:
This app uses your location to guide and assist you during your Umrah and Ziarat journey. Without location access, the app cannot:* Track your movement during **Tawaf** or **Sa’i (Safa–Marwa)** runs.* Show your **current distance from Meeqaat** to help you prepare for wearing Ihram correctly.* Provide accurate **navigation and Ziarat tracking**.

📍 **Important:** If you do not grant location permission, the app will not function properly and you wont be able to use its core features.
